name: Bleeding First Aid
overview: Bleeding Emergency Care is a health topic that clinicians and patients frequently discuss during care planning in India and worldwide. Key considerations include immediate action can prevent complications; call emergency services for severe presentations. This summary is educational and should be paired with professional medical evaluation.

steps.title: Apply direct pressure
steps.description: Use clean cloth and firm pressure on wound for several minutes.

steps.title: Elevate if possible
steps.description: Raise injured limb above heart level when no fracture suspected.

steps.title: Add layers if soaked
steps.description: Do not remove initial dressing; add more material on top.

steps.title: Emergency care for severe bleeding
steps.description: Call ambulance if bleeding spurts or does not slow.

faq.question: Can I rely on this bleeding information instead of a doctor visit?
faq.answer: No. This content supports learning and preparation for conversations with qualified healthcare professionals. It is not a substitute for diagnosis or treatment.

medicalDisclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and does not replace professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider.
